name: Memories of a Dream
source:
Right after graduating from high school you move to Guan Island, a technology center created on an artificial island south of Japan, where you plan to follow in the footsteps of your deceased mentor, carrying on her research in artificial intelligence. But until that day comes, you will live with her daughter, who is also your childhood friend (and also the girl you love).

However, thanks to a red-haired girl appearing in your dreams every night you embark on a journey to learn about lucid dreaming.

[From [url=https://memori-dev.itch.io/memories-of-a-dream]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
高中毕业后，你搬到了关岛，这是一个在日本南部的人工岛上创建的技术中心，你计划在那里追随已故导师的脚步，继续她在人工智能方面的研究。但在那一天到来之前，你将与她的女儿住在一起，她也是你儿时的朋友（也是你爱的女孩）。

然而，由于每天晚上都有一个红发女孩出现在你的梦中，你踏上了了解清醒梦的旅程。

[来自[url=https://memori-dev.itch.io/memories-of-a-dream]Itch.io[/url]]
